## Reproduction rule — i18n.studio-follows-app-locale clause 1

1. Boot the stock showcase (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`), sign in through the form as the seeded admin.
2. Avatar menu → Language → 中文（中国） (equivalently `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/ADMIN_ID {"locale":"zh-CN"}` + reload); the shell turns zh (pillar tab 界面 present).
3. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/interfaces?surface=dashboard%3Ashowcase_chart_gallery`.
4. Read `[data-testid=studio-rail-interfaces]`. Expected (bundle `apps.showcase_app.navigation.*.label`): 能力地图 / 页面搭建 / 工作区 / 数据模型 / 数据分析 / 图表画廊…; actual: "SHOWCASE · 导航 Capability Map … Page Authoring … WORKSPACE DATA MODEL DATA SLICES (FILTERS) ANALYTICS … Chart Gallery …".
5. In the right-hand component list, expected 任务数与平均进度 for widget `combo_count_vs_progress`; actual "Task Count vs Avg Progress".
6. Server truth: `GET /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app/layers` returns the code layer (`"label":"Capability Map"`), while `GET /api/v1/meta/app?package=com.example.showcase` with `Accept-Language: zh-CN` returns 能力地图. objectui `navItemLabelText` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.ts`) resolves only inline I18nLabel maps; same code on objectui main `d66ceea5`.

The dashboards and pages steps should name the one translated widget key and a platform page.
5. `build-gates-hold`: no inaccuracy found; observation only — a one-key removal in one zh-CN file is reported as "2 bundle(s) drifted".
